tasks.title: Search for a product on an online store
tasks.instruction: Visit walmart.com on Chrome. Search for a frying pan, then click on the first product with a pan size of exactly 10 inches and add it to cart.

tasks.title: Translating the language of a webpage
tasks.instruction: Visit www.france24.com/fr. Translate the news page in French on this webpage to English using Google Translate.

tasks.title: Set an alarm on Clock
tasks.instruction: Set an alarm for 8.30 AM that repeats every Monday

tasks.title: Force quit an application
tasks.instruction: Open Chrome and close the application from Task Manager

tasks.title: Recover a photo from Trash
tasks.instruction: Recover the file Task ID 79.jpg from Recycle Bin and verify whether it is restored to its previous location in Documents > Task 79 folder.

tasks.title: Change the theme in Power Point Slide
tasks.instruction: Open Powerpoint Slide "Task ID 41.pptx" in Documents > Task ID 41 folder, and change the presentation theme to "Gallery".

tasks.title: Create a chart in Excel
tasks.instruction: Open Task ID 43.xlsx in Documents > Task 43 folder, create a bar chart where the x-axis is "Book Title" and the y-axis is the "Days to Finish". The title of the chart is "Summer Reading

tasks.title: Copy text from Word to the Notes section in Powerpoint
tasks.instruction: Copy presentation notes from word document located in Task ID 55.docx to my presentation slide Task ID 55.pptx, both in Documents > Task 55 folder.

tasks.title: Convert a file (Excel) into a CSV file
tasks.instruction: Export the Task ID 59.xlsx in Documents > Task 59 folder to .csv and move it to Desktop.

tasks.title: Adjust brightness on photo
tasks.instruction: Open Task ID 77.jpg in Documents > Task 77 folder on Photos app. Turn down the brightness to -1.
